{{Quote|This ship carries the Crest of Alderaan! Is any of the Royal Family on board?|Darth Vader|<ref name="SW1">[[Star Wars (1977) 1|''Star Wars'' (1977) 1]]</ref>}}
The '''Crest of Alderaan''' was the symbol of the [[House of Organa/Legends|House of Organa]].<ref name="SW1" /> It took the form of a [[Gold/Legends|golden]] upside-down triangle<ref name="SG">''[[Shadow Games]]''</ref> made of interlacing curves.<ref name="TFU:CG">''[[The Force Unleashed Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

That insignia was already in use during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]],<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref> around the year [[3643 BBY]].<ref name="STOR">According to [https://web.archive.org/web/20110716175922/http://www.swtor.com/community/showthread.php?p=5365704 this forum post] from lead writer [[Daniel Erickson]], the events of the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' took place ten [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the signing of the [[Treaty of Coruscant]], placing the Alderaanian conflict around [[3643 BBY]].</ref> At the [[Time/Legends|time]], the Crest was featured prominently on the banners hanging from the walls of [[Castle Organa]] on the [[Apalis Coast]].<ref name="TOR" /> Much later, during the three-[[Standard year/Legends|year]] time span of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]] often wore a silver belt buckle in the shape of the Crest of Alderaan.<ref name="BailEncyc">{{SWArchive|url=clonewars/tradingcards/cards/lg_bail_organa.jpg|text=Clone Card: Bail Organa|nobackup=1}}</ref> In the last [[Standard day/Legends|days]] of the [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] culture, that crest was featured on the [[uniform]] collar of the [[Alderaan Guard/Legends|Alderaan Royal Guards]]<ref name="SG" /> and was used to mark royal vessels such as the [[Tantive IV/Legends|''Tantive IV'']].<ref name="SW1" />

Many years after the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction]] of his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], the Alderaanian [[Cal Omas]], who served as the last [[Chief of State (New Republic)/Legends|Chief of State]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], also wore a belt buckle identical to the one Prince Organa once owned.<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Crest of Alderaan was first mentioned in [[1977]], in the [[Star Wars (1977) 1|first issue]] of the [[Star Wars (1977)|''Marvel Star Wars'']] series of comic books, which retelled the opening events of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']].<ref name="SW1" /> It was first seen twenty-eight years [[2005|later]] on a prop belt buckle worn by [[Jimmy Smits]] while playing Bail Organa in [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']].<ref name="ROS">{{Film|III}}</ref> Since then, the Crest has appeared in many episodes of the animated series ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' in which Organa himself appeared.<ref name="TCW:C&M">{{TCW|Cat and Mouse}}</ref><ref name="TCW:HC">{{TCW|Hostage Crisis}}</ref><ref name="TCW:SM">{{TCW|Senate Murders}}</ref>

The portrait of Cal Omas drawn by [[Brian Rood]] and featured in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' showed him wearing the same belt as Bail Organa.<ref name="ERC" /> That rendering of Omas was most likely based on a posed photograph of Organa with his gray jumpsuit and cloak from the [[Polis Massa/Legends|Polis Massa]] sequence in ''Revenge of the Sith''.<ref name="ROS" />
